# Mana Videos Media

> USA Telugu News, Every Morning & Evening. Trusted Telugu news source for the Indian diaspora in America.

## About
Mana Videos Media (@manavideos_media) is a Telugu news outlet serving the Telugu-speaking Indian diaspora in the United States. We publish news roundups twice daily (6 AM and 6 PM CT) covering US politics, immigration, visas, Telugu community events, and India-US relations.

- Website: https://manavideosmedia.com
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/manavideos_media/
- Coverage: US news for Telugu speakers, immigration updates, H-1B, visa news, community events

## Content
- Latest Stories: https://manavideosmedia.com/stories.html
- Archive: https://manavideosmedia.com/archive.html
- RSS Feed: https://manavideosmedia.com/rss.xml

## Key Topics
US immigration policy, H-1B visas, Telugu community news, India-US relations, consular updates, Dallas/Houston/Chicago Telugu events.
